Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:10:1.hebrew: בגוזל ונגזל - וכגון שגזלה עם פירותיה ומכרה. אי נמי, גזלה בלא פירות ומכרה לאחר, ועשה בה פירות, וטוען נגזל: ארעאי אשבח. ומיהו, היציאה שהוציא הלוקח ישלם לו הנגזל, שהרי מתוך כך הושבחה יותר. ואם אין השבח יותר אלא היציאה יתירה, נותן לו יציאה שיעור שבח, ודיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:10:1.english: In [the case of] a robber and a robbery victim - And [this is] such as where he stole it with its produce and sold it. Or alternatively, [where] he stole it without produce and sold it to another, and [the buyer] grew produce in it, and the robbery victim claims: "My land has improved." However, the robbery victim must pay the buyer the expenses that he incurred, since through that it was enhanced more. And if the enhancement is not greater, but rather the expenses are greater, he gives him expenses [up to] the amount of the enhancement, and that suffices for him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:11:1.hebrew: הא כדאיתא כו' - רישא בנגזל, וסיפא בבעל חוב. ולקמיה מותיב לה מרישא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:11:1.english: This is as it is, etc. - The first clause [deals with] a robbery victim, and the latter clause [deals with] a creditor. And later on, [the Gemara] raises an objection to it from the first clause.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:12:1.hebrew: והא לא תני הכי - בברייתא עלה דהך מתניתין דאין מוציאין, דתוקמה בבעל חוב:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:12:1.english: But it is not taught that way - In the baraita on this mishna of "One does not collect," so that you could establish it [as referring to] a creditor.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:12:2.english: And it is removed from his possession - That the court removes it from his possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:12:3.english: When he collects - [The Gemara] explains this below.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:13:1.hebrew: אילימא כדקתני - שלא מכרה גזלן, ומידו היא יוצאה בדין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:13:1.english: If we say as it is taught - That the robber did not sell it, and it is taken from his possession by legal judgment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:13:2.hebrew: גזלן ממאן גבי - ממאן יש לו לגבות, וכי מה נתן בה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:13:2.english: From whom does the robber collect - From whom does he have [the right] to collect? And what did he give for it?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:13:3.hebrew: והשביחה - והרי היא בדין יוצאה מתחת ידו של לוקח, אלמא אית ליה שבחא ללוקח מגזלן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:13:3.english: And [the purchaser] enhanced it - And it is legally repossessed from the possession of the purchaser; evidently, the purchaser is entitled to [compensation for] the enhancement from the robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:13:4.hebrew: שגזל שדה מחבירו ומכרה לאחר והשביח - ונעשה פירות גמורין, ונגזל לוקחה עם פירותיה, ואינו נותן אלא יציאה, דקאמר: ״ארעאי אשבח״, וקתני דלוקח חוזר וגובה מגזלן מן המחוררין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:13:4.english: [Where] one robbed a field from his fellow and sold it to another, and [the purchaser] enhanced [it] - And [the enhancement] became fully developed produce, and the robbery victim takes it with its produce, and he gives [the purchaser] only expenses, for he says: "My land produced the enhancement." And [the baraita] teaches that the purchaser goes back and collects [the enhancement] from the robber, from unencumbered property.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:17:1.hebrew: אמר רבא כו' - האי כשהוא גובה לאו בלוקח קאמר, דבשלא מכרה עסקינן, וגובה את הקרן דקאמר — בנגזל. וא"ת: קרן אמאי גובה מנכסים משועבדים, הרי קרקע לפניו? כגון שחפר בה בורות, דאפחתה משוייה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:17:1.english: Rava said, etc. - This [phrase], "when he collects," does not refer to the buyer, for we are dealing with [a case where the robber] did not sell it; and [that which] it says, "he collects the principal," refers to the robbery victim. And if you say: Why does he collect the principal from liened property; isn't the land right before him? [This refers to a case] such as where he dug pits in it, reducing its value.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:1:1.english: He can withdraw - And [this is] when he did not give money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:1:2.hebrew: אינו יכול לחזור בו - ואפילו לא נתן מעות, שהקרקע נקנית בחזקה, והמעות על זה מלוה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:1:2.english: He cannot withdraw - And even if he did not give money, since land is acquired through an act of possession [chazakah], and the money is a loan upon this [buyer].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:1:3.english: A sack - A sack full of knots.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:1:4.english: From when he treads on the borders - He repairs the borders of the field and raises them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:2:1.hebrew: איכא דאמרי אפי' באחריות נמי - אע"ג דסוף סוף עליה הדר, אין יכול לחזור בו, שהמוכר מעכב עליו. ולא מצי אמר הוא: הואיל וסופך לשלם לי מעותי, השתא דבידי אעכבם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:2:1.english: There are those who say: Even with a guarantee as well - Even though ultimately he [the buyer] will come back upon him [the seller, for reimbursement], he cannot withdraw [from the sale], for the seller prevents him [from doing so]. And he cannot say: "Since you will ultimately repay me my money, now that [it is] in my hands, I will withhold it."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:2:2.hebrew: דאמר ליה אחוי טרפך ואשלם לך - כשיעמידוך ויזכו בדין, ויכתוב לך הדיין שטר טורף עלי שבדין טרפוה ממך בשבילי, בא ואשלם לך. וכל כמה דלא עמדת בדין, איני ירא מהם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:2:2.english: For he says to him: "Show your document of repossession, and I will pay you" - When they bring you to court and prevail in judgment, and the judge writes for you a document of recovery against me [certifying] that they lawfully seized [the field] from you on my account, come and I will pay you. And as long as you have not stood in judgment, I am not afraid of them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:3:1.hebrew: שאינה שלו - שלא היתה של מוכר, שהיתה גזולה בידו, והנגזל בא ומוציא מיד הלוקח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:3:1.english: That it did not belong to him - That it did not belong to the seller, for it was stolen in his possession, and the robbery victim comes and repossesses [it] from the buyer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:3:2.english: He has - The buyer [is entitled to recover his] money from the seller.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:3:3.hebrew: ויש לו שבח - אם זה השביח את הקרקע בזבל או בגדר, קודם שהוציא נגזל מידו, גובה לוקח מן המוכר שבח. ואם תאמר: הנגזל יתן השבח, שהרי השיבו קרקע משובחת? כגון שגזלה משובחת, והכסיפה ביד הגזלן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:3:3.english: And he has [the right to] enhancement - If this [buyer] enhanced the land with fertilizer or with a fence before the robbery victim repossessed [it] from him, the buyer collects [the value of the] enhancement from the seller. And if you say: Let the robbery victim pay [for] the enhancement, for behold, he returned enhanced land to him? [This refers to a case] such as where he [the robber] stole it [when it was already] enhanced, and it deteriorated in the hands of the robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:3:4.english: He does not have [the right to compensation for] enhancement - Later on, [the Gemara] explains the reason.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:4:1.hebrew: פירש לו את השבח - כשמכרה לו, התנה: אם יטרפוה מידך, אשלם לך את השבח, מהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:4:1.english: He specified to him the enhancement - When he sold it to him, he stipulated: "If they seize it from your hand, I will pay you the enhancement" — what is [the halakha]?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:4:2.hebrew: כיון דלית ליה קרקע - הואיל ואין קרקע זו שלו, נמצא שאין כאן שום מכר, והמעות מלוה אצלו, וכשמשלם יותר ממה שנטל, מחזי כרבית:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:4:2.english: Since he has no land - Since this land is not his, it turns out that there is no sale here at all, and the money is [considered] a loan with him. And when he pays more than what he took, it appears like interest.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:4:3.hebrew: אין ולאו - תחילה אמר אין, וחזר ואמר לאו. רפוי היה הדבר בידו, שלא היה יודע טעמו של דבר יפה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:4:3.english: Yes and no - At first he said yes, and then he retracted and said no. The matter was uncertain to him, as he did not know the rationale of the matter well.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:6:1.english: For consuming produce, etc. - [The Gemara] explains them below.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:6:2.hebrew: למזון האשה והבנות - תנאי כתובה שמקבל עליו: את תהא יתבא בביתי ומיתזנא מנכסי; וכן הבנות: בנן נוקבן דיהוו ליכי מינאי, אינון יהון יתבן בביתי ומיתזנן מנכסי עד דתלקחן לגוברין — אין מוציאין לאחד מכל אלו מנכסים משועבדים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:6:2.english: For the sustenance of the wife and the daughters - [These are] stipulations of the marriage contract that [the husband] accepts upon himself: "You shall dwell in my house and be sustained from my property"; and similarly [regarding] the daughters: "The female children that you will have from me, they shall dwell in my house and be sustained from my property until they are married to men" — one does not collect for any of all these from encumbered property.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:6:3.hebrew: מפני תיקון העולם - שאם אתה אומר יטרפו לקוחות על כך, אין לך אדם שלוקח שדה מחבירו, דהא אין לך אדם שאין חוב זה מוטל עליו, ודבר שאין לו קצבה היא, ואכילת פירות ושבח קרקעות נמי דבר שאינו ידוע הוא, ואין הלקוחות יודעין להזהר בכך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:6:3.english: For the betterment of the world - For if you say that [land] may be seized from purchasers on this account, no person would purchase a field from another, for there is no person upon whom this debt is not incumbent, and it is a matter that has no fixed limit; and the consumption of produce and the enhancement of land are also matters that are not known, and purchasers do not know how to take precautions in this regard.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:7:1.hebrew: מאי לאו בלוקח שדה מגזלן - והשביחה, ובא נגזל וטרפה, חוזר לוקח וגובה קרן מן המוכר, אפילו מנכסים משועבדים שמכר זה אחר מכירה זו, דשטרו של זה קודם, שכתב בו אחריות, והשבח מנכסים בני חורין, ולא ממשועבדים, מפני תיקון העולם, שהשבח לא היה קצוב בשעת מכירה, כשקיבל עליו אחריות. אלמא אית ליה ללוקח שבח מגזלן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:7:1.english: What, is it not [referring to] one who buys a field from a robber - and [the buyer] enhanced it, and the robbery victim came and repossessed it, [so] the buyer goes back and collects the principal from the seller, even from encumbered property that this [seller] sold after this sale, for this [buyer's] deed is earlier, as he [the seller] wrote indemnity into it; and [he collects] the enhancement from unencumbered property, and not from encumbered property, for the betterment of the world, because the enhancement was not of a fixed amount at the time of the sale, when he accepted indemnity upon himself. Thus, a buyer is entitled to enhancement from a robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:8:1.hebrew: לא בבעל חוב - שטרפה בעל חוב ממנו בשביל חובו, ולא גזולה היתה, דההיא ודאי אית ליה שבחא, דמכירה מעלייתא היא כל זמן שלא טרפה ממנו, שאם פרע המוכר מעותיו לבע"ח, הרי הוא מסולק מן הלקוחות. הלכך, כי משלם ליה יותר ממה שקיבל, השתא הוא דהדר זבין מיניה קרקע המכורה לו, ולא מחזי כשכר מעותיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:8:1.english: No, in [the case of] a creditor - Where a creditor seized it from him [the buyer] on account of his [the seller's] debt, and it was not stolen, for in that [case] he certainly is entitled to the enhancement, since it is a valid sale as long as [the creditor] has not seized it from him; for if the seller pays his money to the creditor, [the creditor] is removed from [claims against] the purchasers. Therefore, when he [the seller] pays him [the buyer] more than what he received, it is now that he repurchases from him the land that was sold to him, and it does not look like payment for [the use of] his money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:9:1.hebrew: לאכילת פירות - ס"ד הא מיירי בשדה שטרפוה מליאה פירות מיד הלוקח, וחוזר לוקח לגבות מן המוכר. ואי בשטרפה בעל חוב, מי אית ליה לבעל חוב פירות גמורין המחוברין בקרקע, ואינן צריכין לקרקע כלום, שיכול לטורפן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:9:1.english: For consuming produce - It occurred to [the Gemara] that this is dealing with a field that was seized from the buyer [when it was] full of produce, and the buyer goes back to collect from the seller. And if [the case is] where a creditor seized it, does a creditor have [any right to] fully-ripened produce attached to the ground that no longer requires the ground at all, such that he could seize it?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 14b:9:2.english: Collects the enhancement - And [the creditor] seizes the entire land from the buyer, as it has been enhanced by the buyer.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 14b:10:1.hebrew: סיפא נמי בגוזל כו' - מרישא עצמה היה יכול להקשות, כדמקשה בסמוך; אלא, כמה שיכול להקשות משבח גופיה, פריך:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 14b:10:1.english: The latter clause is also regarding a robber, etc. - From the first clause itself [the Gemara] could have objected, as it objects nearby; rather, as much as it can object from enhancement itself, it objects.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 14b:14:1.hebrew: תריץ נמי בבעל חוב - בפרק מי שמת (ב'ב דף קנז: ושם ד"ה גובה) רצה להוכיח דאקני קנה ומכר משתעבד מהכא, דגבי בעל חוב שבח שלא היה בעין בשעת הלואה; ודחי: ר"מ היא, דאמר אדם מקנה דבר שלא בא לעולם. וא"ת: ולוכח משמואל, דאמר בעל חוב גובה את השבח, ושמואל גופיה הוא דבעי ליה התם? דלא מצי למימר דשמואל נמי סבר כר"מ ומבעי ליה אליבא דרבנן, דהא בפרק אע"פ (כתובות דף נט.) פסק שמואל כר' יוחנן הסנדלר, דלית ליה אדם מקנה כו'. וי"ל, דהא דאמר שמואל בעל חוב גובה את השבח, היינו לפי המסקנא דהתם, דפשיט דאקני קנה ומכר משתעבד אף לרבנן. ואם תאמר: אדרבה, לוכח מהכא דלא משתעבד, מדלא טריף בע"ח ממשעבדי דטריף לוקח! דאין לומר דאחר שטרף בע"ח קרקע מן הלוקח קנה המוכר קרקעות ומכרן, דא"כ גם השבח יגבה מהנהו משעבדי, דגם השבח היה קצוב, כיון שכבר טרף הבעל חוב קודם שלקח זה הקרקע. וי"ל, דמיירי שזה הקרקע עשאו המוכר לבעל חוב אפותיקי, ולכך גובה אותו בע"ח, ואע"פ שיש שאר משעבדי. אך קשה: אמאי דחיק לדחויי בפרק מי שמת (ב"ב דף קנז: ושם) "הא מני ר"מ היא"? יעמיד כשעשאו אפותיקי, דאז בעל חוב גובה את השבח היתר על היציאה חנם כדין יורד לתוך שדה חבירו, כדמשמע לקמן! או יעמיד בלוקח מן הגזלן, וכגון שיש לו קרקע או קנו מידו, כדמתרץ לקמן בשמעתין:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 14b:14:1.english: Explain it also regarding a creditor - In chapter Mi Shemet (Bava Batra 157b, and there s.v. Goveh), [the Gemara] sought to prove that [a stipulation of] de-iknei [that property I will acquire shall be liened], where he acquired [property] and sold it, becomes liened, from here [our baraita] — since a creditor collects enhancement that was not in existence at the time of the loan; and [the Gemara there] rejected [this proof, saying that] it is [in accordance with] Rabbi Meir, who says that a person can transfer ownership of an entity that has not yet come into the world. And if you say: Then let [the Gemara] prove [it] from Shmuel, who said, "A creditor collects the enhancement" — and it is Shmuel himself who raised the dilemma there! For one cannot say that Shmuel also holds in accordance with Rabbi Meir, and was raising the dilemma according to the Rabbis, for in chapter Af Al Pi (Ketubot 59a), Shmuel ruled in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan HaSandelar, who does not hold [that] a person can transfer ownership [of an entity that has not yet come into the world], etc.! And it can be answered: That which Shmuel said, "A creditor collects the enhancement," is according to the conclusion reached there [in Bava Batra 157b], which resolved that [property subject to a stipulation of] de-iknei, where he acquired and sold [it], becomes liened even according to the Rabbis. And if you say: On the contrary, let it prove from here [our baraita] that it does not become liened, from the fact that the creditor does not repossess from the liened properties that the purchaser repossesses! For one cannot say that after the creditor repossessed the land from the purchaser, the seller acquired [other] lands and sold them — for if so, [the purchaser] should also collect the enhancement from those liened properties, since the enhancement was also of a fixed amount, inasmuch as the creditor had already repossessed before this [subsequent buyer] purchased the land. And it can be answered: It is dealing with [a case where] the seller designated this land as an apoteiki [specific security] for the creditor, and therefore the creditor collects it, even though there are other liened properties. Yet it is difficult: Why did [the Gemara] go out of its way to reject [the proof] in chapter Mi Shemet (Bava Batra 157b, and there) [by saying], "In accordance with whose [opinion] is this? It is Rabbi Meir"? Let it establish [the baraita as a case] where he designated it as an apoteiki, for then a creditor collects the enhancement in excess of the expenses for free, in accordance with the law of one who enters another's field [without permission], as is implied below [15b]! Or let it establish [the baraita] as referring to one who purchases from a robber, and where [the robber] has land, or they acquired from his hand [formalizing the obligation via a kinyan], as is answered below in our sugya [15a].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 14b:3:1.hebrew: ויש לו שבח - שהנגזל לוקח הקרקע עם השבח, ואינו משלם ללוקח רק היציאה, כדין יורד לתוך שדה חבירו שלא ברשות, דאם השבח יתר על היציאה, נותן לו את היציאה; ואותו שבח היתר יקח הלוקח מן הגזלן. ומיירי שנגזלה ריקנית:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 14b:3:1.english: And he has [a right to] the enhancement - For the victim of the robbery takes the land with the enhancement, and pays the buyer only the expenses, in accordance with the law of one who enters another's field without permission, for if the enhancement exceeds the expenses, he gives him the expenses; and that surplus enhancement, the buyer shall collect from the robber. And [this] is dealing with [a case where] it was stolen empty.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 14b:3:2.hebrew: ושמואל אמר מעות יש לו - אפילו קנאה שלא באחריות, כדפי' לעיל. וכן משמע דמיירי דומיא דהכיר בה שאינה שלו דלקמן, דמיירי על כרחך שלא באחריות, כדקאמר שמואל מעות מתנה; דאי באחריות, אמאי מעות מתנה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 14b:3:2.english: And Shmuel said: He has the money - Even if he purchased it without a guarantee, as explained above. And it is also implied that [the Gemara] is dealing [with a case] analogous to [the case of] "he recognized that it was not his" below [15b], which perforce is dealing [with a purchase] without a guarantee, as Shmuel says: "The money is a gift"; for if [it were purchased] with a guarantee, why would the money be a gift?
